title: Brandolini’s Law Explained: Why It’s Harder to Debunk Nonsense Than Create It
description:
Ever felt exhausted trying to correct nonsense online? That’s where Brandolini’s Law, or the Bullshit Asymmetry Principle, comes in. It says: “The amount of energy needed to refute bullshit is an order of magnitude bigger than to produce it.” In other words, it’s easy to create nonsense, but hard work to debunk it.

This video explores how Brandolini’s Law plays out in the real world—from conspiracy theories like flat earth, fake moon landing claims, and 5G paranoia, to pseudosciences like homeopathy, astrology, and Ayurveda. We’ll also show how this law applies in politics, religion, and social media, where misinformation spreads faster than facts.

Using examples from climate change denial, anti-vaccine propaganda, ghost stories, and WhatsApp forwards, Pale Blue Thoughts explains why bad ideas go viral while scientific corrections struggle to catch up. If you’ve searched for Brandolini’s Law explained, Bullshit Asymmetry Principle, why misinformation spreads, conspiracy theories debunked, or how to fight pseudoscience, this video gives you the rational perspective.

Don’t forget to subscribe, like, comment, and share — hype this video so it reaches more people and sparks better conversations!

Chapters
00:00 – Introduction: Why nonsense spreads so easily
02:10 – What is Brandolini’s Law? The Bullshit Asymmetry Principle
05:00 – Conspiracy theories: flat earth, moon landing, 5G
09:20 – Pseudosciences: homeopathy, astrology, Ayurveda
13:00 – Politics, religion, and social media nonsense
16:30 – Climate denial and anti-vaccine propaganda
20:00 – Why facts take more energy than lies
23:00 – Conclusion: Fighting back against misinformation
